title: A Structural Reevaluation of the Collapse of World Trade Center 7 – Final Report
source_name: University of Alaska Fairbanks, Institute of Northern Engineering (final report linked from the project page https://ine.uaf.edu/wtc7)
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology
publication_status: University research report (INE Report 18.17, final), following a draft released for public comment on 2019-09-03. Not a journal article. The report lists two external reviewers it calls 'external peer reviewers'; independent journal peer review is not established. About WTC 7, not the Twin Towers.
disclosures: Funded by Architects & Engineers for 9/11 Truth (AE911Truth), an advocacy organization: the report states it was 'Prepared for: Architects & Engineers for 9/11 Truth' and thanks AE911Truth 'for providing the funding'; the UAF project page lists AE911Truth as funder with a project budget of $316,153.
rights: No license stated in the document. The PDF is hosted on wtc7report.org, which the UAF project page links as the final report. Kept local; not redistributed.
